4use crate::third_party::vello_common::fearless_simd::*;
5use crate::third_party::vello_cpu::fine::Splat4thExt;
6use crate::third_party::vello_cpu::peniko::{BlendMode, Compose};
7
8pub(crate) trait ComposeExt {
9    fn compose<S: Simd>(&self, simd: S, src_c: f32x16<S>, bg_c: f32x16<S>, alpha_mask: Option<f32x16<S>>) -> f32x16<S>;
10}
11
12impl ComposeExt for BlendMode {
13    fn compose<S: Simd>(&self, simd: S, src_c: f32x16<S>, bg_c: f32x16<S>, alpha_mask: Option<f32x16<S>>) -> f32x16<S> {
14        // There some non-obvious subtleties worth highlighting here.
15        // We support two kinds of blending (in this case, we focus on compositing specifically):
16        // - Isolated blending, where layers as a whole are blended together with their backdrop.
17        //   If we are currently performing this kind of blending, `alpha_mask` will always be `None`.
18        //   After all, there is no concrete shape opacity associated with a layer. Instead, we are
19        //   just compositing the RGBA values at _all_ positions of the source layer with the backdrop
20        //   layer. For example, if the backdrop contains a green rectangle and source layer is just
21        //   empty, if we perform blending with `Compose::Clear`, then _everything_ will be cleared,
22        //   because we are compositing the whole source layer with the whole backdrop, and not
23        //   just the parts of the source layer that have actually be drawn on.
24        // - Non-isolated blending, where a single path is blended with the backdrop. In this case,
25        //   `alpha_mask` _might_ be `Some` and contain the alpha values of the strips we are currently
26        //   compositing. Remember that strips always have a fixed height of 4, because of this, the
27        //   strips might cover areas that aren't actually covered by the path (and just have an alpha
28        //   value of 0, or a value between 0-254 for anti-aliased parts). Because of this, for
29        //   non-isolated blending, we need to lerp the result with the backdrop using `alpha_mask`.
30
31        let mut res = match self.compose {
32            Compose::SrcOver => SrcOver::compose(simd, src_c, bg_c),
33            Compose::Clear => Clear::compose(simd, src_c, bg_c),
34            Compose::Copy => Copy::compose(simd, src_c, bg_c),
35            Compose::DestOver => DestOver::compose(simd, src_c, bg_c),
36            Compose::Dest => Dest::compose(simd, src_c, bg_c),
37            Compose::SrcIn => SrcIn::compose(simd, src_c, bg_c),
38            Compose::DestIn => DestIn::compose(simd, src_c, bg_c),
39            Compose::SrcOut => SrcOut::compose(simd, src_c, bg_c),
40            Compose::DestOut => DestOut::compose(simd, src_c, bg_c),
41            Compose::SrcAtop => SrcAtop::compose(simd, src_c, bg_c),
42            Compose::DestAtop => DestAtop::compose(simd, src_c, bg_c),
43            Compose::Xor => Xor::compose(simd, src_c, bg_c),
44            Compose::Plus => Plus::compose(simd, src_c, bg_c),
45            // Have not been able to find a formula for this, so just fallback to Plus.
46            Compose::PlusLighter => Plus::compose(simd, src_c, bg_c),
47        };
48
49        if let Some(alpha_mask) = alpha_mask {
50            let alpha_mask_inv = 1.0 - alpha_mask;
51            res = alpha_mask * res + alpha_mask_inv * bg_c;
52        }
53
54        res
55    }
56}
57
58macro_rules! compose {
59    ($name:ident, $fa:expr, $fb:expr, $sat:expr) => {
60        struct $name;
61
62        impl $name {
63            fn compose<S: Simd>(simd: S, src_c: f32x16<S>, bg_c: f32x16<S>) -> f32x16<S> {
64                let al_b = bg_c.splat_4th();
65                let al_s = src_c.splat_4th();
66
67                let fa = $fa(simd, al_s, al_b);
68                let fb = $fb(simd, al_s, al_b);
69
70                if $sat { (src_c * fa + fb * bg_c).min(f32x16::splat(simd, 1.0)).max(f32x16::splat(simd, 0.0)) } else { src_c * fa + fb * bg_c }
71            }
72        }
73    };
74}
75
76compose!(Clear, |simd, _, _| f32x16::splat(simd, 0.0), |simd, _, _| f32x16::splat(simd, 0.0), false);
77compose!(Copy, |simd, _, _| f32x16::splat(simd, 1.0), |simd, _, _| f32x16::splat(simd, 0.0), false);
78compose!(SrcOver, |simd, _, _| f32x16::splat(simd, 1.0), |_, al_s: f32x16<S>, _| 1.0 - al_s, false);
79compose!(DestOver, |_, _, al_b: f32x16<S>| 1.0 - al_b, |simd, _, _| f32x16::splat(simd, 1.0), false);
80compose!(Dest, |simd, _, _| f32x16::splat(simd, 0.0), |simd, _, _| f32x16::splat(simd, 1.0), false);
81compose!(Xor, |_, _, al_b: f32x16<S>| 1.0 - al_b, |_, al_s: f32x16<S>, _| 1.0 - al_s, false);
82compose!(SrcIn, |_, _, al_b: f32x16<S>| al_b, |simd, _, _| f32x16::splat(simd, 0.0), false);
83compose!(DestIn, |simd, _, _| f32x16::splat(simd, 0.0), |_, al_s: f32x16<S>, _| al_s, false);
84compose!(SrcOut, |_, _, al_b: f32x16<S>| 1.0 - al_b, |simd, _, _| f32x16::splat(simd, 0.0), false);
85compose!(DestOut, |simd, _, _| f32x16::splat(simd, 0.0), |_, al_s: f32x16<S>, _| 1.0 - al_s, false);
86compose!(SrcAtop, |_, _, al_b: f32x16<S>| al_b, |_, al_s: f32x16<S>, _| 1.0 - al_s, false);
87compose!(DestAtop, |_, _, al_b: f32x16<S>| 1.0 - al_b, |_, al_s: f32x16<S>, _| al_s, false);
88compose!(Plus, |simd, _, _| f32x16::splat(simd, 1.0), |simd, _, _| f32x16::splat(simd, 1.0), true);
